2317-4826-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
2317-4826-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3534-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
3534-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.
3534-7084-8227.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

1479-2443-2841-6517.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-6517.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2590-5776-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2590-5776-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

628-4247-5405.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, optionally putting -1/-1 counter(s) on another creature.
Resolve the Soulstinger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1170-1976-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

4826-5900-7898.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts.
4826-5900-7898.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Smaug.
When Smaug enters, its first ability triggers, creating a number of Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.

3819-5671-7114.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Lake of the Dead from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Lake of the Dead into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Lake of the Dead from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Lake of the Dead from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Lake of the Dead into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.
3819-5671-7114.notes: You can return other lands with their dredge abilities instead, as you're able to do so.

969-3259-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3967-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3967-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7338.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1887-3899-4552-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-6723-7075-7295.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6723-7075-7295.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

57-4846-5295-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-4846-5295-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-4017-4050-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4050-6720.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

549-856-4050-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

317-1482-5660.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-4050-4321-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4050-4321-5631.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

3490-4050-4716-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-4716-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Prosperous Innkeeper indestructible.
3490-4050-4716-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

141-695.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Settle Beyond Reality.
141-695.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Settle Beyond Reality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Settle Beyond Reality, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

583-1000-2104-2493.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
583-1000-2104-2493.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast Sram's Expertise by paying {2}{W}{W}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer and allowing you to cast a card with mana value 3 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Temporal Manipulation, and Sram's Expertise to your hand.
Repeat.
